errors.name: CustomerNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a customer is requested by ID but not found in the database.

errors.name: ProductNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a product is requested by ID but not found in the database.

errors.name: CategoryNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a category is requested by ID but not found in the database.

errors.name: OrderNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an order is requested by ID but not found in the database.

errors.name: OrderItemNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an order item is requested by ID but not found in the database.

errors.name: InvoiceNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an invoice is requested by ID but not found in the database.

errors.name: InvalidOrderStatusError
errors.description: Raised when an order status is set to a value not in the allowed set: pending, confirmed, shipped, cancelled.

errors.name: InsufficientStockError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to confirm an order that would result in insufficient stock for one or more products.

errors.name: InvalidPriceError
errors.description: Raised when a product price is set to a negative or non-numeric value.

errors.name: InvalidProductIdError
errors.description: Raised when a product ID is used in an order but not present in the product catalog.

errors.name: OrderAlreadyConfirmedError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to confirm an order that is already confirmed or cancelled.

errors.name: OrderCannotBeCancelledError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to cancel an order that is not confirmed.

errors.name: OrderCannotBeShippedError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to ship an order that is not confirmed.

errors.name: MalformedCSVError
errors.description: Raised when a CSV file is malformed or cannot be parsed during import.
